status.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/desoto-falls-recreation-area ('Site Open'; 'Camping at DeSoto Falls Recreation Area is open') + the forest's alerts page (no DeSoto Falls alert; all 23 sites 'Open' on recreation.gov), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Water (showers, flush toilets, hydrants) only April 1 - October 31; from November 1 to March 31 all water is off and fees are reduced.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/desoto-falls-recreation-area ('This campground is open all year long, and seasonal rates apply') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/240242 ('During non-peak season (November 1 - April 1), all water is turned off to the entire campground'), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/240242 ('NOTE: There are no hookups or a dumpstation avaliable in the campground'; all 23 sites typed NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 23 sites in an upper and a lower loop; every site is back-in or parallel. Only about ten list an RV or camper-van length of 24 ft or more (sites 4, 5, 6, 12, 15, 18, 20, 21, 22, 23: 24-40 ft); the rest list 14-18 ft or no RV length, and two are tent-only. Pick a site that lists 24 ft+.

sites.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 240242 (permitted equipment max lengths: RV/Caravan 40 at 4, 22, 23; 36 at 18; 30 at 15, 20, 21; 24 at 5, 6, 12; 14-18 at 7, 8, 13, 17, 19; Driveway Entry Back-in or Parallel at every site) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/240242 ('23 campsites are neatly arranged in two loops(upper and lower)'), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/240242 ('April 1st through October 31st, the campground has drinking water, warm showers, and flush toilets... Centrally located in the upper loop is a vault toilet... There are no hookups or a dumpstation'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $20 a night April 1 - October 31, $10 November 1 - March 31 when the water is off; the double site (#14) is $40 / $20.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/desoto-falls-recreation-area ('Standard Nonelectric - $20.00', 'Standard Nonelectric - $10.00', '$20 per night/site', '$40 Double Site (Site #14)') + recreation.gov rates (Peak 2026-04-01 to 2026-10-31 and 2027: Standard non-electric 20; Non-Peak 2026-11-01 to 2026-12-31 and 2027: 10), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 'Reservations are required to camp in this campground... You may reserve camp sites the same day as you arrive and as far as six (6) months in advance. However, reservations cannot be made on-site.'

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/desoto-falls-recreation-area ('The Interagency Senior and Access Passes and the Golden Age and Access Passports are accepted. These passes entitle the pass holder to a 50% discount for single family campsites'), read 2026-10-29

note: USFS Chattahoochee NF, Blue Ridge Ranger District, on US-129 north of Cleveland. Upper and lower loops along Frogtown Creek, with creek sites in each; DeSoto Falls trail on-site. --Claude
summary: FS page and recreation.gov: campground open (no Helene or other closure; forest alerts list none for DeSoto Falls), open all year with water Apr-Oct only, $20 peak / $10 off-peak (2026-2027), reservations required (same day to 6 months, none on-site), no hookups or dump, showers/flush toilets seasonally plus a vault toilet, senior pass 50%. Confirmed 23 sites, max 40 ft, phone 706-745-6928. Added: about ten sites list 24-40 ft (the rest 14-18 ft), none pull-through. Note: ranger district corrected to Blue Ridge (FS page and rec.gov address), the '~30-ft trailer' and '18-ft group site' claims dropped (catalog: trailer lengths unstated; site 14 is the double site, length unstated), counts/hookups/booking moved to fields.
flags: Pin off by ~380 m: stored 34.71196,-83.91646; the 23 recreation.gov site coordinates centre on 34.70931,-83.91384 (sites span 34.7072-34.7107, -83.9152 to -83.9131).

Rig fit: only about ten of 23 sites list an RV/camper-van length of 24 ft or more (4, 5, 6, 12, 15, 18, 20, 21, 22, 23); the others list 14-18 ft or none. A 23-ft motorhome must book one of those - not a criteria failure, but tight.
